title: A Visitor for the Bell
author: Tamsin Halloran
blurb: Mirabel Hartwell, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must finish the ritual the founders started, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
